name: Trust Amendment / Restatement
description: Amendment or complete restatement of a revocable trust, reviewed for the power-to-amend citation, execution formalities, and integration. Selects the EST-414..418 ruleset (5 checks).

distinguishing_phrases: the settlor reserved the right to amend
in all other respects the trust is ratified

compliance_matrix_columns: Original trust identified by name and date
Power to amend cited and method followed
